title: Kadar language — Grokipedia
text: The Kadar language, a Southern Dravidian tongue, features a consonant inventory characteristic of its family. The stops include bilabial /p/, dental /t/, retroflex /ʈ/, palatal /c/, and velar /k/, along with their voiced counterparts /b/, /d/, /ɖ/, /ɟ/, and /g/.
